name: @unframework.dev/toolchain-vue-vapor
description: The vue-vapor test toolchain: Vue 3.6, whose runtime and compilers every vue-vapor layer resolves from here (ADR-0112), the checker and tsconfig that type-check every case's vue-vapor golden output in one run (L4), and the oxlint and ESLint (eslint-plugin-vue) configs that lint it (L5).
